quarterly_data.quarter: Nanya Technology press release: Nanya Technology July 2026 Revenue NT$ 43,868 Million (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nanya reported unaudited July 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$43,868 million, up 49.27% MoM and 719.61% YoY; year-to-date revenue NT$175,504 million, up 660.87% YoY. The company attributes the MoM increase to the transition from expired to new contracts: expired annual, semi-annual and quarterly contracts were fulfilled as scheduled, and new contracts took effect in July with terms and duration negotiated based on customer requests.
quarterly_data.figure: July revenue NT$43,868 million (+49.27% MoM, +719.61% YoY); YTD NT$175,504 million (+660.87% YoY)
